title: Block Oscillator Factorization
body_html:
Block Oscillator Factorization

For the block decomposition \(W=\boxplus W\oplus\boxminus W\), the finite oscillator representation and the stabilizer action factor as \[ \omega_w=\omega_{\boxplus S}\otimes \omega_{\boxminus}. \] The off-diagonal factor \(\omega_{\boxminus}\) is isomorphic to the off-diagonal Heisenberg-Weil factor \(\kappa_{\boxminus}\).
proof_html:
Extraction

The generalized lattice model decomposes according to the orthogonal direct sum of residual symplectic spaces. Lemma 8.4 identifies the off-diagonal Lie layer with the off-diagonal residual oscillator space, and the same phase computation as in the one-block case identifies the pulled-back oscillator action with the Heisenberg-Weil factor. The block-diagonal part is exactly the product of the top-block and lower-block lattice models.
